# eon_restore_account_region_aws_subnets (Data Source)

Retrieves the subnets available to Eon in a region of a restore account. Use this data source to select values for `eon_restore_job` network configuration, such as `subnet_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List subnets available in a region of a restore account
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_subnets" "demo" {
  account_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  region     = "us-east-1"
}

output "subnet_ids_by_vpc" {
  description = "Subnet IDs grouped by VPC ID"
  value = {
    for subnet in data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_subnets.demo.subnets : subnet.vpc => subnet.id...
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.
- `region` (String) Region where the subnets are located.

### Read-Only

- `subnets` (Attributes List) List of subnets available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone the subnet is in.
- `cidr_block` (String) Primary IPv4 CIDR range of the subnet.
- `id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the subnet.
- `name` (String) Name of the subnet. Null if the subnet has no name.
- `vpc` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the VPC the subnet is in.
